question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Sitting on the fence**
solution: The correct answer is: **Remaining undecided**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Sitting on the fence"** refers to avoiding making a decision or choosing between two sides. (निर्णय न लेना या किसी पक्ष का समर्थन न करना) • **Example:** When asked about the controversial topic, she was sitting on the fence and refused to take a stand. • **"Remaining undecided"** means being unable or unwilling to make a decision or commitment. (निर्णय लेने में असमर्थ या अनिच्छुक होना) • **Example:** He remained undecided about whether to accept the job offer or not. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Remaining undecided**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Supporting the weaker side** (कमजोर पक्ष का समर्थन करना): Choosing to assist the party or side that is at a disadvantage. • **Example:** She always supports the weaker side in debates to make the discussion fair. • **Taking immediate action** (तुरंत कार्रवाई करना): Acting without delay or hesitation. • **Example:** The fire department took immediate action to control the blaze. • **Speaking openly** (खुले तौर पर बोलना): Expressing one’s thoughts or opinions without hesitation or fear. • **Example:** He is known for speaking openly about social issues, even if it is controversial. 42:T96e, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "To admit something honestly".
